Thanks, Dylan. Jamie, welcome — I reviewed Ava's onboarding form and the SKU list. Two notes:

- We need the SKU merges to be explicit in a revised CSV (please add a new column "merge_to_code" for any SKUs that should collapse). That prevents duplicate line items in our ledger.
- For initial PO issuance, Procurement prefers one PO per supplier for onboarding and uses line-item tags to separate SKU clusters. Finance sets the spend cap.

Marcus — can you confirm the provisional spend cap for Q4? If we give a $50k provisional cap, Procurement will mark the PO as provisional and add a 30-day review clause. Once approved by finance we will issue PO.

Jamie — please send SKU_list_v2.csv with the merge_to_code column and a short note if any price tiers change. I'll queue the supplier record once that's in.

Regards,
